What happens here

This is QSC's first facility, dedicated to mechanical and electrical repair, diagnostics and scheduled care. Every visit starts with diagnosis and ends with a documented report.

Key services

Mechanical

Mechanical Repair

Mechanical faults in a premium vehicle rarely announce themselves politely: a new vibration at speed, a knock on cold starts, play in the steering, a drivetrain that no longer feels tight.

Learn more →
Mechanical

Engine Repair

Modern luxury engines are dense, electronically managed systems where a single symptom can have several plausible causes.

Learn more →
Mechanical

Transmission & Gearbox

Gearbox behaviour is one of the clearest signatures of a luxury car's condition.

Learn more →
Diagnostics & Electrical

Auto Electrical

A modern luxury car carries dozens of control modules on shared networks, which is why electrical faults are notorious for being intermittent and misleading.

Learn more →
Diagnostics & Electrical

Computer Diagnostics

A diagnostic scan is only as useful as the interpretation behind it.

Learn more →
Diagnostics & Electrical

ECU Programming

Replacing a module in a modern luxury car is rarely plug-and-play: new units must be programmed and coded to the specific vehicle, and many persistent electronic complaints are ultimately software-level issues.

Learn more →
